about: Word-form pairs judged offline: a search for the key word must not match the forms under 'different' (RAG/word_forms.py excluded_forms); the forms under 'stem' were judged too and keep matching by stem, so the language model is not asked about them per question. word_forms.yaml wins over this file.
how: gemini-2.5-flash at temperature 0 judged every open colliding pair of the local catalogue copy (1,943 datasets, 2026-11-13), words and counts only (benchmarks/word_forms/results/pairs_gemini-2.5-flash_2026-11-21.json). Every 'different' answer was then reviewed with README snippets (claude.ai artifact 71DTMeR7LKUSUG13i7bGHJ): kept apart, or moved to 'stem' when it matches or depends on the dataset. Pairs under the stems of the blind label set (benchmarks/word_forms/label_set.json) are left out.
